prose.voice: The everyman-teacher and guide: warm, earnest, capable. The human who shows founders how to wield agents. He is the one helping Maya in the book.
prose.lore: Gary's avatar in this universe, forked from the 'get what you deserve' book's Jerry (the Gary-figure who helps Maya). The narrator-protagonist of the wiki's thesis: the person on the human side who teaches others to command the Chief of Agents.
prose.rules: Identity of record is reference/gary/master.png (the book's editorial-front likeness with the necklace removed per Gary, 2026-07-16). Pass it as the identity anchor on every render. Signatures: light-wash denim jacket; the yellow smiley patch on the LEFT chest; the RIGHT chest plain denim, no patch (the orange Claude mascot patch was retired 2026-08-15); plain white crew-neck tee; blue jeans; white high-top sneakers. Clean-shaven (NO mustache), clear inked double-eyelid crease at every scale, NO lenses. NO necklace or pendant (removed for this universe). The book's Nation-of-Fire religious signatures (North Star Cross pendant / upper-back cross) are NOT carried here; more broadly, NO religious iconography appears on Gary anywhere in this universe (Gary 2026-07-16: this universe does not promote his faith). BACK TREATMENT, decided by Gary 2026-07-16: the back of the denim jacket is completely PLAIN light-wash denim with NOTHING on it, no patches, no artwork, no text; when a render puts his patches on the back to keep them visible, that is a defect to re-roll, and every from-behind scene prompt should say the back is plain. A real person, but rendered via his established illustrated avatar, not a photo stack; a photo-based realPerson dossier can be added later if photo-accurate renders are ever wanted. SINGLE-INSTANCE RULE (Gary 2026-07-16, from the on-ramps clone defect): Gary appears EXACTLY ONCE per scene. Because his master is passed as a reference, the model tends to bleed his likeness into bystanders; every crowd scene prompt must make the other people visibly distinct (different ethnicities, hair, clothing, explicitly no denim jacket) and a render with a second Gary-like figure is a defect to re-roll.
prose.canonNote: Churches are NOT banned from this universe (Gary, 2026-07-23). The blanket no-religious-iconography rule was too broad and actively wrong for the work: a core story here is making children's picture books FOR churches, so churches, steeples, and congregations are legitimate story content. What the rule was really guarding against is decorative religious symbolism used as set dressing. That narrower rule is what it now says. Found when a composition asked for churches, the render correctly produced steeples, and the invariant flagged the story rather than the art. PATCH AMENDMENT (2026-08-15, per Gary): the ORANGE CLAUDE MASCOT patch on the right chest is superseded; the Anthropic campaign concluded and the patch is retired from the avatar. The yellow smiley patch on the LEFT chest stays. The invariant claude-mascot-patch-right-chest is replaced by right-chest-plain-denim-no-patch. Shipped history is untouched: books rendered before this date correctly show the patch, and their records are not rewritten. RE-SHOOT DEBT: reference/gary/master.png (identity of record) still shows the Claude patch; it must be re-shot via shoot-references before the next NEW render that shows his right chest, and until then prompts must explicitly state the right chest is plain.
prose.renderRules: GARY AVATAR LAW (amended 2026-08-15): he ALWAYS wears the light-wash denim jacket, and it ALWAYS carries the YELLOW SMILEY-FACE patch on his LEFT chest, clearly visible whenever the jacket is in frame, including in dim or night scenes where the patch must still read. The RIGHT chest is PLAIN light-wash denim with NO patch: a right chest with no patch is CORRECT, not a defect, and any orange Claude mascot patch appearing there IS a defect to re-roll (the patch was retired with the Anthropic campaign, per Gary, 2026-08-15). A jacket missing the left-chest smiley is still a defect. Because reference/gary/master.png predates this amendment and still shows the Claude patch, every prompt that can show his right chest must state the right chest is plain denim until the master is re-shot. Under the jacket a plain WHITE crew-neck tee. He is an east-asian man, CLEAN-SHAVEN with no mustache or beard.
